steps.content: Back here again.
The ruins are a labyrinth, but at least the buildings are real. Solid. Unlike your progress, which has somehow landed you at this same broken pillar for the fourth time.
You're running on empty. One hand slaps against the cold stone for support while the other digs into your shaking knee. You can't seem to catch your breath.

And the monsters won't stop. They slither out of shadows, teeth and claws and wrongness, and Lichen deals with each one like it's nothing, but it's not nothing to you. Every appearance grinds down what's left of your composure. You're close, too close to breaking.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Sigh, still can't find the way out? Just as that one said, the more souls wandering the Realm of Yang, the more tangled the path becomes... Heh. A clever snare. Either we all lose our way together, or we're picked off one by one.
She starts chuckling, as if admiring a well-crafted puzzle.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Spirits don't win with force. They win with cunning.
Behind her, in the shadowed corner, something stirs. A mass of darkness writhes, wet and slow. You open your mouth to warn her—
Slash!
Her fist clenches—backward, without looking—and golden light erupts from nowhere. The monster is simply gone, crushed into nothing.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: We can't linger. If we don't find my shifu before dusk...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Well, a perfect chance to try that little trick.
Your question hangs in the air, unanswered. She's already pacing, already pulling out an array of curious objects, already lost in her own excited murmurings. To her, you've ceased to exist.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Where the Yin energy pools, spirits cling...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: With blood as the lure, the body as the bait, they shall find their anchor.

In the span of a breath, she's arranged it all: a ritual formation laid out with casual precision. Above, clouds swallow the sky, drowning every last ray of light. But the red threads still glow, an eerie crimson defiance against the dark. At the center, a bottle. And from it rises the sickly-sweet scent of blood.
Lichen...? Lichen!
She finally registers that you're there, but doesn't stop. Instead, she simply turns and gives you a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: That look again. You never seem at ease around me, young friend. I told you I'd keep you safe. Is my word so hard to trust?
But look at what you're doing...
The monsters she crushed like bugs were terrifying. But not as terrifying as her—the way her eyes gleam now, the strange cheerfulness in her voice.

And it's not just her. Behind her, inside the formation, something is happening. Dark mist gathers, churns, lives. Whispers spill out, fragmented and wrong. Your chest tightens. You can barely draw air. Does she not see it? Or—
She waves a casual hand toward the roiling dark and says, almost proud:

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Well, since you asked... This place is thick with phantoms, and phantoms can bridge the gap between worlds.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: So, according to Volume 999 of my shifu's Whimsical Musings, why not just open a ghost gate and "invite" them over for a proper chat?
You're luring them out on purpose?!

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: To commune with all things is to know the true Dao of heaven and earth. Professor <color=#fb9259>Shin</color> also found the practice fascinating. She has a sharp eye for such things.
...You're on her side? You actually agree with her—

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...Agree or not, it matters little. It's just an old saying—

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: If I learn the truth at dawn, I can die content by dusk.
The formation is now alive. Threads pulse with growing rhythm, and you realize with horror that you have no idea when this began, or how.

She stands at its heart, serene, as violent winds tear at her clothes. The bell swings in frenzy, its ringing accelerating until it's not separate chimes but one endless, piercing shriek that flays your senses.
The terror returns. It sinks into your marrow, your blood, your breath. You can't let this continue. You won't. You have to stop her.
Stop! Just... stop! You think just because you call them, they'll give you answers?!
Don't bargain with spirits! Don't ask them for truths! They always demand a price!!

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: A price? Then let them come to collect. If they can, I'll gladly owe them one.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: But if they can't... well, they'll have to concede defeat.

Her words hang in the air, then the bottle explodes. Light floods everything, impossibly bright, throwing her face into stark relief. The ruins before you rip apart as reality itself twists and warps, revealing something beyond: darkness so profound it feels solid, pierced by chaotic, flickering light.
From that tear, they come. Phantoms unlike any before—bodies twisted into shapes of pure agony, faces frozen in eternal screams. They lunge at you with shrieks that should shatter your soul...
[Transition for 1s, screen shakes, white flash effect]
And they stop. Right there. Right in front of you.
Whoosh—!!!

Crimson flames roar upward, consuming the spectral figures in a heartbeat. One moment they're there, the next, ash drifting on scorched air. Beyond the fire, through the wavering heat, Lichen catches your eye and offers you a smile.
Then she turns to face the rest of them. And that gentle smile hasn't changed at all.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: With my body as the offering, the dead shall be ferried... Open—!
